title: Central Cagayan Agta language - Wikipedia
text: Central Cagayan Agta, also known as Labin Agta, is an Austronesian language and Aeta language of northern Cagayan Province, Philippines. It is spoken by the Aeta Negritos in inland areas located to the east and northeast of Baggao.
